verdict.rationale: Bento's own docs say natural-language alert rules can route to a webhook alongside Slack, PagerDuty, and email. That is a first-party outbound HTTP callback, but only for alert firings, and it appears as a single-line mention. Missing for 10: documented event types beyond alert fires (e.g., issues, signals, deploys), webhook registration/management docs or API, payload schema, signing/verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
